mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_realtime_status ( activity_id, user_id, status, longitude, latitude, last_report_time ) VALUES ( #{activityId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{lastReportTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), longitude = VALUES(longitude), latitude = VALUES(latitude), last_report_time = VALUES(last_report_time), is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT id, activity_id, user_id, status, longitude, latitude, last_report_time, ROUND( 6371000 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT( POW(SIN((RADIANS(latitude) - RADIANS(#{latitude})) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(#{latitude})) * COS(RADIANS(latitude)) * POW(SIN((RADIANS(longitude) - RADIANS(#{longitude})) / 2), 2) )), 2 ) AS distance_meter FROM user_realtime_status WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND status != 'OFFLINE' AND is_deleted = 0 ) nearby WHERE distance_meter <= #{radiusMeter} ORDER BY distance_meter ASC, last_report_time DESC
